Date: 2028-09-14T14:11:02Z
Subject: ACTION: Clearline eastus2 spike — recommend prioritized fallback to eastus1 (need exec sign-off for SLA credit)

Team —

Summary: Clearline (DL-4987) is experiencing a 4x token-latency increase and rising 5xx rate across eastus2 since ~13:50 UTC; customer traffic is high-value (retail checkouts). Customer requests immediate failover to eastus1.

Proposal (recommended):
- Apply a temporary routing override: pin Clearline traffic to eastus1 for their production route (priority routing policy)
- Enable burst capacity on their Dedicated pool for the next 60 minutes to absorb resharding
- Turn on conservative prefix caching bypass for 15 minutes to avoid stale KV cache issues during region swap
- Offer a one-week SLA credit if net availability < 99.5% post-incident (ops to quantify)

Risks: potential cold-cache latency on eastus1, KV-cache divergence for in-flight sessions, small window of tail-latency spikes during drain.

Needs:
- Rishi: quick assessment of runbook risk and execution ETA (10–20 min)
- Marissa: can you prepare exec note and customer-facing communication?
- Sean: authorize priority pin and burst capacity (I will attach the runbook for approval)
- Priyom: please create an INF JIRA (INF-7321) and record immediate metrics

Related artifacts: eastus2-fallback-runbook.pdf (attached). Drive link: https://drive.redwood.company/drive/folders/clearline-incident-20280914

Vanessa

Subject: Re: ACTION: Clearline eastus2 spike — recommend prioritized fallback to eastus1 (need exec sign-off for SLA credit)

Vanessa / team —

Checked service mesh + infra telemetry: eastus2 shows an abnormal queueing pattern on gpunode-pool-12 and higher token queue length for the model shards Clearline uses. We've reproduced a tail-latency amplification when small bursts chain with delayed KV reads.

Execution plan (I will run):
1) Warm-sync eastus1 replicas (30s)
2) Apply routing override for Clearline customer ID -> eastus1 (rolling policy)
3) Lift priority pin after 45 minutes and monitor 10m window

ETA to apply step 2 after approval: ~10 minutes from now (14:34 UTC). Command snippet (internal):
---
# prioritize routing for customer
redwoodctl routing override --customer DL-4987 --region eastus1 --duration 45m --priority high
---
Notes: this will cause a prefix revalidation for ~2% of sessions; recommend we notify Clearline about possible short-lived additional latency for in-flight sessions.

I'll capture logs into INF-7321.

Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
